description: Starts navigation of an existing page to the specified URL.

tag.description: Optional exact tag to persist on the resulting navigation history entry.

purpose.description: Describe why this URL is needed for the task, e.g., opening a product detail page or returning to search results

url.description: Destination URL dispatched to the browser.

title.description: Document title observed immediately after dispatch; it may still belong to the previous document.

status.description: Page lifecycle status observed immediately after dispatch; later events may advance it.

accepted.description: Whether the navigation request was dispatched to the browser.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.
